title: Accelerating the Discovery of Abiotic Vesicles with AI-Guided Automated Experimentation.
summary: Automated experiments and microscopy support vesicle compositions and formation constraints; the result concerns abiotic amphiphile assembly only, not biological delivery or dissemination.
organization: Central Connecticut State University; Fordham University

evidence.tested: Automated experiments and microscopy support vesicle compositions and formation constraints; admission is limited to abiotic amphiphile assembly, not biological delivery or dissemination.
